title: Local CSV checker
objective: Import a redacted CSV, identify missing columns and duplicate rows, and export errors without modifying the source.
data: Public CSV fixtures; inspect existing code, tests and lockfiles.
output: Working import, validation, results and export with a change note and actual test results.
acceptance: Test valid, empty, missing-column, duplicate and cancellation cases; inspect desktop and narrow layouts; list unrun checks.
recovery: Preserve original data; record changed files and last passing commands; revert only this change; approve release separately.
excluded: No framework replacement, unknown dependencies, commits, pushes or deployment.
